title: Litenova Page Acceptance Criteria
description: The acceptance record beside one page. Every acceptance-criterion identifier a page sidecar names has one entry here and one runnable file the entry points at.

schemaVersion.$comment: Each release pins one exact shape. A consumer adopting a later release absorbs every difference at that moment, so no minor-compatible range exists between two releases. See standards/rule/core-authoring.publish-each-release-as-a-complete-contract and standards/rule/core-authoring.exclude-cross-release-compatibility-work.

spec.$comment: A path relative to this record, so the file that proves the criterion sits beside the page it proves.
